standard: ACTION_BY_MANIFEST; every transition ends ALLOW, DENY or FAIL_CLOSED; no new external machines or dependencies
credential_authority: TV/TVC only; no non-TV/TVC secret or token is introduced or moved
invariants: Every repository-authored workflow file must be explicitly registered in surfaces[] before merge/push. Unregistered workflow proliferation fails closed (tests/test_workflow_surface_registry.py).
A new check is a group in tools/tasks/task_catalog.json run by the stable validator dispatcher, never a new workflow file.
Registered triggers and permissions equal the workflow file's own; a drift fails closed.

No surface carries workflow_dispatch, schedule, repository_dispatch, issues or workflow_run unless its registered exception names it; release is carried only by the registered release lifecycle surface.
Each folded workflow's verbatim record is pinned by sha256 and its run blocks equal the catalog step bodies (tests/test_folded_workflow_records.py).

unregistered_workflow_outcome.required_evidence_or_repair: register the file in control/workflow-surface-registry.json surfaces[] with a classification, or fold it into tools/tasks/task_catalog.json

surfaces.lifecycle: validation: every pull_request and every push to main; read-only; runs tools/tasks/task_catalog.json; the release readiness chain runs as four jobs keyed on the upstream job result
release lifecycle: a release becoming published; read-only; runs the catalog groups declaring the release event

lifecycle_trigger.rationale: release: published is a state transition of the repository (a release object reaching published), not an external machine; it is the only event build-and-attach-release, downstream-propagation and release-assets (push tags v*) observed. Kept as the second of two surfaces; no third workflow.
